from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashReport(BaseModel):
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the financial report belongs to")
    cash_and_cash_equivalents_at_end_of_period: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of Cash and Cash Equivalents at End of Period")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The specific date marking the end of the financial period")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_reports: list[CompanyCashReport]
